intro: Find a shop by name or code. Or open your own shop and start selling.
noStores: No shops found. Check the name or code.
manualPaymentNotice: Payments go directly to the seller. This service does not hold money.
cachedWarning: Saved data: offline. Prices and stock may have changed.
stockFinalAtAcceptance: Stock is confirmed when the seller accepts the order.
replaceCart: Your bag contains another shop’s products. Replace the bag?
stockLimit: No more observed stock available. Refresh the product.
cartEstimate: These prices are estimates. Review the latest total before ordering.
pendingCheckout: The previous order result is not confirmed. Check or retry the same request before starting another order.
reviewAgain: Verify no order exists and review again
acceptanceNotice: Your order is confirmed only after the seller accepts it.
waitToPay: Do not pay until the seller accepts your order.
trackingPrivacy: Keep this key private. Anyone with it can view the order summary.
refundNotice: A seller refund is required. The system does not refund money automatically.
payDirect: Pay the seller directly using these instructions:
verifyPayment: Check your account. Confirm only after the payment or refund has actually happened.
sellerIntro: One account, one shop. You can also buy from other shops.
name: Name
createStoreIntro: Start with your shop name, contact, delivery and payment details.
checklist: Complete profile → Add products → Publish shop → Share code.
storeSuspended: An administrator suspended this shop. You can still resolve existing orders.
deleteAccountWarning: This permanently deletes your account. Your name, email, shop contact and payment details and uploaded photos are removed, your shop is unpublished and your products are archived. Past order records are kept without your personal details. This cannot be undone.
deleteAccountConfirm: Permanently delete your account? This cannot be undone.
commaRegions: Separate with commas, e.g. Area A, Area B
productModerated: An administrator removed this product from sale.
photoHelp: Save the product first. Up to 3 photos, 5 MB each. JPEG, PNG or WebP.
resetSent: If the account exists, a message has been sent.
resetHelp: Copy both codes from the email and choose a new password.
linkUnavailable: Could not open the page. Check your internet connection.
sessionExpired: Your session expired. Sign in again.
connectionUnknown: Connection not confirmed. Check your internet and retry. This action has not been marked successful.
